normal.name: Chris Pirillo
normal.text: A disc that nothing on that machine could open becomes a drive letter you can type at a prompt, and that covers a lot of machines people still keep in a closet. Do you keep an old DOS or Windows 95 computer around for games or old files?

normal.name: Chris Pirillo
normal.text: Do you keep an old DOS or Windows 95 computer around for games or old files? Then a DVD drive in it may finally be useful for moving files in and out. Back up your startup files before you install any driver on a machine you care about, and test it with a disc you can afford to lose. Old […]

normal.name: My little retro computer world
normal.text: Wo ist Fritz? Indiana Jones and the Fate of Atlantis (1992), one of my all-time favourites and the adventure game closest to my heart. The floppy version, running on my DX4-100 DOS PC with a Roland MT-32. Just listen to that soundtrack. #RetroGaming #DOS #MT32 #LucasArts

normal.name: MadDamo (Wish it were the 80's Pat!)
normal.text: I've been doing this for a *long* time. 26 years since my first PC game (and many small unfinished ones before). Havent released anything in years but I remember you first popping up a while back and seeing you continue to create and release stuff helps me keep faith in the profession. Indies FTW!

normal.name: Tiah Marie Beautement
normal.text: Policy gives me the chills. 14 years ago I was dragged into a school meeting with principal & vice for my 7 year old. They offered to “fix” my son. The problem? He played with girls and his best friend was a girl. And I didn’t restrict his toys and games to “boy” ones.
normal.media: quotes @taniel.bsky.social: In a bonkers policy, a central New York school district has decided that schools must tell parents if they found out a student is gay or tr…

normal.name: H.B Gamer
normal.text: Drawn to Life (Nintendo DS) Finally finished a game I remember from my childhood. Its charming and the drawing aspect is amazing. The gameplay though I feel is just ok as the platforming is fine but the level design is a mixed bag. Bosses are also kind of annoying. That said good game. 7/10

normal.name: An Nimh (HERbert)
normal.text: After playing Ocarina of Time, my nostalgia brought me over to Super Mario Galaxy—the game that had my dad STOP playing video games because he’d get sick to his stomach 🤪 Me? Played it so many times!
What was the first video game you ever played?

normal.name: Putuk
normal.text: For a long time I've had vague memories of some weird old PC game I played as a kid, all I recalled it had "cyber"-something in the title. I was never able to find it, but THIS IS IT!!! I'll have to look into it sometime.

heated.text: I hate how boomy this makes me sound, but this AI hardware bubble has gotta GO. 6 year old console is more expensive than it was at launch? Back in my day, a 6 year old console cost $250 and came with 2 of the best games available bundled in for free.
